content: Secrets + agents: 12,000+ live API keys found in public LLM training datasets; prompts/agent messages are hidden leak layer; once pasted into third-party AI chat, treat as compromised — rotate immediately. Best practice: vault/central secret manager, secrets injected at runtime never in prompts/markdown/config, automated rotation with overlapping validity windows, granular scoping per action not blanket account access, secret-scanning hooks in repo, non-human identity verification for agent credential release.
